name: A Philosophical Discussion of Worms
source:
When Vynder awakes in a house he doesn't recognize, with nothing but the clothes on their back and a hazy memory of what had happened, they search for a way out. Finding endless hallways and a library filled with books.

He is alone in a house with nothing but a ghost to keep them company.  But even the ghost wont stick around long enough for Vynder to talk to. 

---

When Ophiel awakes in a house they don't recognize, tucked away in the far corner, navigating dim corridors in search of anything  to pass the time.  Secret passages and locked rooms greet them at every turn.

They are alone in a house with a ghost that haunts them around every corner, always finding them in every twisting passage they take, calling out to them, but they never listen.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4264150/A_Philosophical_Discussion_of_Worms/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当维德在一座他不认识的房子里醒来时，除了背上的衣服和对所发生的事情的模糊记忆之外，什么都没有，他们寻找出路。找到无尽的走廊和装满书籍的图书馆。

他独自一人住在一所房子里，除了一个鬼魂陪伴他们之外什么也没有。但即使是鬼魂也不会停留足够长的时间让维德与之交谈。

---

当奥菲尔在一间他们不认识的房子里醒来时，他躲在远处的角落里，在昏暗的走廊里走来走去，寻找任何可以打发时间的东西。秘密通道和上锁的房间随时都会迎接他们。

他们独自一人住在一所房子里，鬼魂在他们的每个角落里出没，总是在他们走过的每一个曲折的通道里找到他们，呼唤他们，但他们从不听。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4264150/A_Philosophical_Discussion_of_Worms/]Steam[/url]]
